{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:15.671135Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:15.670342Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:16.940830Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:16.936871Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:16.943579Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:16.942878Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.876612Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.873873Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.879445Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.879022Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.889490Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.887956Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.893811Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.891869Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.924971Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.922644Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.984\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.983\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     938.9\n",
      "Date:                Wed, 26 Aug 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           2.98e-41\n",
      "Time:                        17:03:19   Log-Likelihood:                0.98499\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             6.030\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             13.68\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.9916      0.084     59.207      0.000       4.822       5.161\n",
      "x1             0.5124      0.013     39.410      0.000       0.486       0.539\n",
      "x2             0.5592      0.051     10.940      0.000       0.456       0.662\n",
      "x3            -0.0213      0.001    -18.615      0.000      -0.024      -0.019\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.215   Durbin-Watson:                   2.697\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.898   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.414\n",
      "Skew:                           0.057   Prob(JB):                        0.813\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.569   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.928698Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.928337Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.936079Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.933976Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.46028674  4.97459726  5.44536017  5.84210009  6.14534003  6.34980145\n",
      "  6.46527145  6.51499482  6.53185498  6.55297131  6.61360056  6.74134425\n",
      "  6.95161383  7.24509863  7.60765258  8.01261838  8.42520723  8.80821452\n",
      "  9.12813245  9.36065526  9.4946726   9.53409491  9.497211    9.41368319\n",
      "  9.31967391  9.25190429  9.24162102  9.30946256  9.46206834  9.6909879\n",
      "  9.97406928 10.27909852 10.56909234 10.80837436 10.96843666 11.03262352\n",
      " 10.99886793 10.88003118 10.70178981 10.49841699 10.30715156 10.1620798\n",
      " 10.08853511 10.09893588 10.19074509 10.34688722 10.53855364 10.72993585\n",
      " 10.88410866 10.96909692]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.941199Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.940938Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.951295Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.948676Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.94813544 10.78007299 10.4868389  10.11840737  9.74056198  9.41878965\n",
      "  9.20224709  9.11172559  9.13456052  9.22773213]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.955278Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:19.955067Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.416354Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.415694Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7f091a7bfb60>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.427809Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.427387Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.445982Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.442874Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.450205Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.449970Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.460928Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.457079Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.991571\n",
       "x1                  0.512429\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.559190\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.021251\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.463745Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.463473Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.472884Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-26T17:03:20.470892Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.948135\n",
       "1    10.780073\n",
       "2    10.486839\n",
       "3    10.118407\n",
       "4     9.740562\n",
       "5     9.418790\n",
       "6     9.202247\n",
       "7     9.111726\n",
       "8     9.134561\n",
       "9     9.227732\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
